newsitem.title: USA: Aetna cuts '97 enrollment growth outlook.
newsitem.headline: Aetna cuts '97 enrollment growth outlook.

text.p: Aetna Inc said on Tuesday it reduced its 1997 commercial HMO and Medicare enrollment growth outlook to 10-11 percent from 13-15 percent.
The company did not forecast the outlook for 1998 enrollment growth.
But an Aetna spokeswoman said some of the slower growth has come as the company has resisted reducing prices to attract business.

"Part of our strategy is to hold firm on prices, to hold the line on prices," Aetna spokesman Patty Seif said. "In doing that you walk away from some business because the price isn't right," she said.
Although the company has sacrificed some growth, she said, by holding firm on prices, it has been able to hold the line on margins.
